title: TEST ONLY — Mood-to-Music Companion
profile: Fast-moving learner with hidden asynchronous state misconceptions.
goal: Build a small accessible React interface with explainable recommendations and honest source boundaries.

sessions.title: Mocks before access
sessions.learner_prediction: A track title containing calm proves the track will feel calming.
sessions.learner_attempt: Render three mock track objects and choose a calm mood.
sessions.observation: Mock objects render; title-to-emotion inference is unvalidated.
sessions.correction: Metadata is not a measured emotional response.

decision.choice: Begin with listener feedback and transparent tags
decision.reason: The product can help without claiming objective emotional truth.

sessions.unresolved: Real API capabilities and rights are not verified yet.
sessions.next_action: Define the card contract and one keyboard-usable mood control.
sessions.evidence_boundary: All learner activity is scripted simulation. Artifacts may be executed by the lab runner; that does not prove a human learner executed or understood them.

sessions.title: API feasibility gate
sessions.learner_prediction: We can use audio features from any newly created developer app.
sessions.learner_attempt: Read current authoritative Spotify documentation before choosing an integration.
sessions.observation: The lab must insert a dated authoritative capability receipt; this fixture intentionally does NOT assert current availability.
sessions.correction: Treat capability as unverified until the research receipt is attached.

decision.choice: Keep integration behind an adapter and mock fallback
decision.reason: External capability and account eligibility can change.

sessions.unresolved: No Spotify login, request, save or playback was executed.
sessions.next_action: Inspect documented access mode, endpoint availability and account restrictions.
sessions.evidence_boundary: All learner activity is scripted simulation. Artifacts may be executed by the lab runner; that does not prove a human learner executed or understood them.

sessions.title: Late response wins incorrectly
sessions.learner_prediction: The last response to arrive must belong to the current mood.
sessions.learner_attempt: Select calm then energetic; resolve the energetic request first and calm request last.
sessions.observation: A naive implementation displays calm tracks under an energetic heading.
sessions.correction: Arrival order differs from intent order; guard updates with request identity or cancellation.

decision.reason: A deterministic delayed promise test reproduces the race without credentials.

sessions.unresolved: Aborting an operation alone may not cancel every already-started continuation.
sessions.next_action: Predict and run the two-request schedule; retain loading, empty and error states.
sessions.evidence_boundary: All learner activity is scripted simulation. Artifacts may be executed by the lab runner; that does not prove a human learner executed or understood them.

sessions.title: Requirement changes
sessions.learner_prediction: We should delete all the earlier reasoning because the plan changed.
sessions.learner_attempt: Abandon objective mood scoring and request personally labelled favourites instead.
sessions.observation: The source limitation and feedback rationale still explain the new design.
sessions.correction: Abandoned approaches remain useful historical context; they are not current instructions.

decision.reason: It remains useful while API feasibility is unresolved and respects personal variation.

sessions.unresolved: Real external-service capability must be supplied by the dated research receipt.
sessions.next_action: Implement and test one feedback update without mutating the original track array.
sessions.evidence_boundary: All learner activity is scripted simulation. Artifacts may be executed by the lab runner; that does not prove a human learner executed or understood them.
